description.en: A five-page native DSH workbench to choose Legion members, discover session tools and Skills, search configured plugin indexes and public GitHub, and explicitly install or enable native capability bundles. Includes connection settings, task details, and separate run, artifact and download status. Source adaptation and collaboration use a separately configured, user-authorized Legion core; no core, external harnesses, models or credentials are bundled.
description.zh: DSH 原生五页军团工作台：选择成员、查找会话工具与 Skill、搜索已配置插件索引和公开 GitHub，并明确安装或启停原生能力包；提供连接配置、任务详情，分别呈现运行、成果和下载状态。源码适配与协作交给另行配置并获授权的军团核心，不捆绑核心、外部 Harness、模型或凭据。
